output.name: ECOs stalled at change board with no visible owner or escalation
output.summary: Engineers see their ECOs sit at the change board for weeks with no visible holder, and must raise a ticket to find out who has them and get them moving, often when a plant deadline is near.

root_cause.text: Likely the change board approval step has no due date, automatic reminder, or escalation, and the current approver is not surfaced to requesters, so ECOs stall until a human chases them.

quotes.quote: My ECO has been at change board for three weeks and nobody can tell me why.
Showed the user the Route tab; change coordinator sent a reminder.

evidence.text: Every resolution is identical: point the user to the Route tab and have the change coordinator send a manual reminder, meaning nothing in the system fixed itself.

quotes.quote: Showed the user the Route tab; change coordinator sent a reminder.
Showed the user the Route tab; change coordinator sent a reminder.

evidence.text: Users cannot tell who currently holds the ECO, which suggests the pending approver is not visible to them.

quotes.quote: Can someone check who is holding my ECO? It has not moved since last month.

evidence.text: Stalls last weeks to a month, which suggests no time-based escalation on the change board step.

quotes.quote: ECO waiting at change board for weeks
It has not moved since last month.

evidence.text: The delays threaten plant timelines across many part families.

quotes.quote: ECO for 210-008054 is stuck; plant needs it next week.
ECO for 450-008487 is stuck; plant needs it next week.

output.fix: Add a due date to the change board workflow task with automatic reminders to the assigned approver, escalation to the change coordinator when it is overdue, and a requester notification that names the current holder.
